title: MCIC: Automated Identification of Cellulases From Metagenomic Data and Characterization Based on Temperature and pH Dependence.
summary: MCIC combines sequence similarity with an ensemble ML model to identify cellulases and predict pH/temperature optima; two camel-rumen candidates were cloned, expressed and characterized. Evidence is limited to the stated retrospective/in-silico/prototype setting. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
